content: The standard SQL Server table-queue claim pattern is UPDATE ... WITH (ROWLOCK, READPAST, UPDLOCK) ... OUTPUT ... WHERE status='pending', exactly as SPEC.md 5.7 already specifies. READPAST skips rows locked by other claimants (no blocking), UPDLOCK holds the row for the claiming transaction, ROWLOCK prevents lock escalation to page/table level. This lets N worker processes poll concurrently without colliding.
